title: Why Overhead Downlights Alone Flatten Luxury Architecture
caption:
Relying solely on overhead downlights casts harsh shadows under brow-lines and flattens natural stone textures.

At LITELAB, every residential and monumental commission is engineered around our three-tier architectural layering methodology:

1. Ambient Cove & Indirect Illumination (2700K) for calm spatial volume.
2. Precision Focal Grazing (15° narrow beam, CRI 97+) to bring travertine, fluted timber, and artwork to life.
3. Decorative & Human-Centric Warm Dimming for evening visual comfort (UGR < 16).
